# Catppuccin

Official color palette from https://github.com/catppuccin/palette, version 1.8.0.
MIT License; Copyright (c) 2021 Catppuccin.

The four palettes in `themes/catppuccin-*.json` adapt these colors to Turtle Code
interface, syntax highlighting and terminal roles. The editor surfaces and
syntax colors follow the Catppuccin Neovim previews and highlight conventions
from https://github.com/catppuccin/nvim (MIT License, Catppuccin contributors).
